title: Navigating Transitions: Bold Leadership for Uncertain Times
description: Geopolitical instability, climate disruption, shrinking civic space — the leaders who navigate this moment well aren't the ones with the most certainty. They're the ones who've learned to move with integrity through what they don't fully understand. This talk draws on Gilberto's experience across WEF, EU institutions, and frontline climate work to explore what bold leadership actually looks like when the map runs out.
